title: Can You Label Less by Using Out-of-Domain Data? Active & Transfer Learning with Few-shot Instructions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification performance (using AUC metrics) of pre-trained language models via few-shot instruction prompting on the Social Bias Frames (SBIC) dataset to detect if social media posts project biases, stereotypes, or are offensive toward a group.

Measuring the models' ability to detect hate speech, general offensiveness, aggression, and targeted insults using few-shot instructions on the HASOC (Hate Speech and Offensive Content Identification) dataset.
Applying active and transfer learning with few-shot instructions to classify toxicity, disrespect, and sexually explicit harassment in the #MeToo Twitter dataset.
